dataset.name: Great St Bernard tunnel toll, Saint-Rhémy (northbound)
dataset.method: Tunnel du Grand-Saint-Bernard (SISEX SA, Swiss side; SITRASB S.p.A., Italian side): one-way tariff from 2026-02-01, paid at the plaza where the trip enters, in CHF on the Swiss side and EUR on the Italian side: trucks over 3 m high with 2 axles (class B2), 3 axles (3A) or 4 or more (4). Trucks over 3.5 t are taken to be over 3 m high.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

vehicles.description: Trucks over 3 m high (here: over 3.5 t), by axles

network.description: The Great St Bernard tunnel, charged at the Saint-Rhémy (northbound) plaza.

tax.note: Not recorded as a field in the source table; dataset.method says where the sources state it.
